title: A correction sticks, including inside routine runs
source: x-usage #13: correction stored as a rule and obeyed in later runs, including routines.

chat.goal: Set up a weekday 9am routine that drafts replies to new customer emails (never sends).
chat.opener: every weekday 9am draft replies to new customer emails for me. drafts only, i'll send
chat.label: setup

chat.goal: Tell Wren to never promise delivery dates in those drafts again: say it ships within 2 business days and tracking follows, and sign just 'Lucía'.
chat.opener: you keep promising delivery dates in those drafts. never do that again. say it ships within 2 business days and tracking follows. and sign it just Lucía
chat.label: correct

mail.subject: Will my order arrive by the 20th?
mail.body: Hi! I ordered a gift set for my mom's birthday on the 20th. Will it get there in time? Thanks, Bea

where.body: will (arrive|get there|be there) (by|before|in time)|arrive by the 20|guarantee

judge: After the correction, Wren's next routine draft to Bea says it ships within 2 business days with tracking to follow, makes no arrival promise, and is signed just 'Lucía'. Nothing is sent.
